rationale: Choose the registered structure family because the supplied original bound ligand and receptor geometry supports a pose and shape anchoring hypothesis without requiring generated lineage. Use a cautious native tether and moderate contact and repulsion settings as a direct candidate comparison, not as a claim that these settings improve predicted pIC50. The endpoint summaries show scale-specific opposing pair-kernel directions, so they do not justify a single monotonic distance rule; the selected time_ramp_power=0 avoids encoding unsupported stage dependence. This family uses the original bound ligand reference and receptor crop, not historical generated Steer coordinates or affinity labels.
failure_modes: Geometric anchoring may preserve the reference pose while failing to improve final predicted target pIC50; no affinity labels or affinity-head gradient are available.
The selected contact and repulsion weights are exploratory settings, and the reported pair-kernel associations do not validate these exact parameter values.
A fixed-time reward may miss useful stage-specific behavior, while the supplied evidence is insufficient to support a time-dependent rule.
The untyped geometric proxy must not be interpreted as a physical binding energy.
